decisionSummary: Release 0.2.3/v5 from the common main and dev-publish head: protected setup-token sign-in, descriptor-only runtime credential delivery, persistent private directories, and safe sign-out. Shell 105 supplies the declared private procfs. Publication and installation require governed terminal receipts and live UI acceptance.

checks: Full app tests, race detector, vet and module verification passed; vulnerability scan found no vulnerabilities.
Five compiling mutations rejected unsafe credential files, shell secret echo, public directory modes, rejected-token reset and viewer writes.
Actual packaged Claude consumed a synthetic token descriptor with private procfs and no network; local rendered sign-in, restart persistence and sign-out passed.
